title: Jest mocking fails with circular dependencies
description: When attempting to mock UserRepository in controller tests, Jest throws circular dependency errors due to module-load-time instantiation. Controller instantiates repository at module-load time, causing Jest mock hoisting issues.

resolution.approach: Switched to integration-style tests with real DB instead of mocked repository
resolution.rationale: Avoid Jest mocking complexity, use real database for simpler tests. Integration-style unit tests provide same coverage without mocking fragility.

workaround: Use integration tests instead of unit tests with mocks
prevention: Document in learnings: Prefer integration-style tests for layered architecture to avoid Jest mocking complexity
